severity_classes.name: Critical service outage or unsafe client/advisor impact
severity_classes.business_impact: Client/advisor-impacting Idea service outage, data-safety risk, unauthorized exposure risk, or unsafe opportunity workflow behavior.

severity_classes.name: Material workflow degradation
severity_classes.business_impact: Core opportunity workflows, evidence generation, downstream handoff, or operator recovery is materially degraded but bounded mitigation exists.

severity_classes.name: Limited supportability or non-critical workflow issue
severity_classes.business_impact: Internal operator, proof, telemetry, or non-critical workflow issue with no current client/advisor impact.

severity_classes.name: Tracked defect or documentation correction
severity_classes.business_impact: Low-risk defect, stale operational guidance, or improvement item that does not require active incident coordination.

escalation_roles.responsibility: Own severity, incident timeline, containment decision, recovery authorization, communication cadence, and final closure decision.
escalation_roles.escalation_condition: Required for every Sev1 and for Sev2 incidents that cross a supported runtime, data-safety, production identity, or customer-impact boundary.

escalation_roles.responsibility: Own app behavior diagnosis, source-safe evidence capture, fix-forward plan, regression tests, and issue/PR tracking.
escalation_roles.escalation_condition: Required for every Idea incident or supportability defect.

escalation_roles.responsibility: Own ingress, deployment, runner, release image, environment, shared observability, and platform automation diagnosis.
escalation_roles.escalation_condition: Required when readiness, release identity, deployment, ingress, capacity runner, or platform-owned evidence is implicated.

escalation_roles.responsibility: Own PostgreSQL backup, restore, PITR, credential rotation, provider restore identity, and database cutover support.
escalation_roles.escalation_condition: Required when durable repository, backup, restore, PITR, corruption, or data-loss risk is implicated.

escalation_roles.responsibility: Own sensitive-data exposure assessment, evidence redaction, credential rotation decision, and privacy/legal escalation handoff.
escalation_roles.escalation_condition: Required when secrets, entitlements, tenant isolation, personal data, audit records, AI lineage, or legal/privacy lifecycle may be affected.

escalation_roles.responsibility: Own source-system or downstream-system diagnosis without transferring source authority to Lotus Idea.
escalation_roles.escalation_condition: Required when Core, Performance, Risk, Advise, Manage, Report, Render, Archive, Gateway, Workbench, or AI ownership is implicated.

prohibited_content: candidate id unless already source-safe and explicitly allowed
raw exception text containing environment details
source_safe_evidence_policy.evidence_storage: Attach source-safe artifacts to GitHub issues, PRs, workflow artifacts, or repo-authored output summaries only after redaction review.

communication_policy.customer_communication_boundary: Lotus Idea engineering may draft source-safe impact facts, but external customer or client communication requires the governed customer-communications owner and must not imply suitability, execution, reporting, archive, legal, privacy, or production certification authority.

non_proof_boundaries: This contract is not production on-call staffing certification.
This contract is not protected-environment incident drill evidence.
This contract is not customer-communication approval.
This contract is not legal, privacy, suitability, execution, report rendering, or archive authority.
This contract is not authentication or authorization implementation.
This contract is not deployment or production certification.
This contract is not data-mesh certification.
This contract is not Gateway or Workbench proof.
This contract is not supported-feature promotion.
